title: Financial Assistance Awards and the Genetic Cancellation Fee Basis
content:
A patient's award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program reduces the fee basis of the genetic cancellation handling fee for a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class.

**Clause.**

- When the patient holds an approved assistance case whose award start date is on or before today, whose award end date is on or after today, and whose tier is the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment, the fee basis is reduced by **100 percent** of itself.
- When the approved case covering today is of any other tier, the fee basis is reduced by that tier's discount percentage.
- A patient with no approved award covering today has no assistance reduction of the fee basis.

| Approved award covering today | Fee basis reduced by |
|---|---|
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | 100 percent of itself |
| Any other tier (for example Financial Assistance 50% Discount) | that tier's discount percentage |
| None | nothing |

**Worked figures (hypothetical fee basis of 120.00).** With a Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment award covering today, the fee basis becomes 0.00. With a Financial Assistance 50% Discount award covering today, it becomes 60.00. With no award covering today, it stays 120.00.

**Coverage of today (hypothetical dates, today 15 May).**

| Award start | Award end | Covers today |
|---|---|---|
| 1 January | 15 May | Yes (the end date is on or after today) |
| 15 May | 31 December | Yes (the start date is on or before today) |
| 1 January | 14 May | No |
| 16 May | 31 December | No |

An application still under review is not an approved award and brings no assistance reduction.
